dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.setupProfile: Fill in your profile with your personal data
dashboard.setupFirst: Send your first removal requests to data brokers
dashboard.nothingToDo: Nothing to do. All requests are in progress.

brokers.title: Data brokers
brokers.intro: Select companies and create requests. The curated list comes from public privacy policies (as of Oct 2026) and should be double-checked before sending.
brokers.name: Name
brokers.dataUrls: Where your data appears (URLs, one per line)
brokers.dataUrlsHint: These links are inserted into the request.
brokers.newIntro: For any website or company that shows your data. The app searches the website for a privacy contact address.
brokers.curatedReadonly: Curated entries cannot be edited. Create your own copy to adjust contact details.
brokers.deleteBrokerHint: Also deletes all requests to this entry.

requests.title: Requests
requests.empty: No requests yet. Select companies under “Data brokers”.
requests.subject: Subject
requests.autoRemind: Remind automatically when the deadline passes
requests.escalationIntro: The deadline has passed and the reminder was unsuccessful. You can now file a complaint with the supervisory authority.
requests.idWarning: This recipient usually requires proof of identity. Expect a follow-up question.

profile.title: My profile
profile.intro: These details are inserted into requests so recipients can find your records. Provide only what is necessary.
profile.aliasesHint: Former names, spelling variants, maiden name. One per line.
profile.addressesHint: Your current address and previous addresses that data brokers may have on file.
profile.legacyAddresses: These addresses come from the old free-text field. Please re-enter them below in structured form so they are used in requests.

mail.title: Mail account
mail.intro: Requests are sent through your own mailbox. Replies are read via IMAP and matched to requests automatically (reference in the subject). Passwords are stored encrypted.
mail.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored password.
mail.imapSameCreds: Leave empty to reuse the SMTP credentials.
mail.hint: Tip: use a dedicated address such as privacy@yourdomain.com so replies arrive in one place. For Gmail use an app password; for Proton use Proton Bridge.

templates.title: Templates
templates.intro: System templates for GDPR, Swiss FADP and CCPA. You can override any template for yourself. Placeholders in double curly braces are replaced when a request is created.
templates.subject: Subject
